messages:
Elena: deploy-bot aborted today's promote. wheel build for service-notify failed during pip install against our private PyPI mirror. tagging @Build-Kevin and @SRE-Lucy because this blocks the 14:00 UTC change window.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Job 9966 FAILED: pip.install_error. error: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement redwood-utils==1.7.3 (from -r requirements.txt (line 12)) while resolving index=https://pypi.internal.redwood/

Build-Kevin: I'm seeing the same locally when using the mirror. Direct pip install from pypi.org returns 1.7.3. Mirror metadata shows latest=1.7.1. Looks like the mirror proxy missed the latest sync.

Max: Two quick unblock choices: 1) re-run CI pointing pip to public index (risky for reproducibility), 2) pin to the last known-good image built with redwood-utils 1.7.1, or 3) vendor the wheel into the build artifacts and re-publish. Pin is fastest; vendoring is a follow-up.

SRE-Lucy: I'll invalidate the mirror cache and kick a resync job to pick up 1.7.3, but propagation takes ~5-10m. If we wait we might miss the change window. I'll open INC-2026-150 and add the cache invalidation steps.

Janet: PM prefers minimal risk to customers. If 1.7.3 is only a non-critical utility bump, pinning to the last good image is acceptable for today's cut. Please include a release-note about deferring the dependency upgrade.

Elena: Confirming the impact: redwood-utils 1.7.3 fixes a logging noise and a non-blocking metrics label. No functional user-facing changes. I'll patch the promote manifest to image-tag=v2026-03-22-build-887 and re-run deploy-bot. Also adding a note to the release that dependency bump is deferred.

SRE-Lucy: Mirror resync started. Logs:
```
2026-03-24T13:47:02Z mirror-sync: fetch index redwood-utils -> ok
2026-03-24T13:47:07Z mirror-sync: update metadata -> latest=1.7.3
2026-03-24T13:47:09Z cache-invalidate: key=packages/redwood-utils -> success
```

Build-Kevin: Recommend follow-up: add a preflight check that validates mirror index vs upstream for critical deps. Also consider marking certain packages as "vendor-first".

deploy-bot: [ACTION] Manual image-pin requested by Elena. Promote queued for v2026-03-22-build-887. Smoke expected in ~3m.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Smoke for v2026-03-22-build-887 PASSED. Promote completed.

Elena: Cut complete. Release note added: "Promotion paused due to private PyPI mirror returning stale metadata for redwood-utils; promoted last-known-good image while mirror resynced (INC-2026-150). Dependency upgrade will be retried after mirror validation."

Janet: Good decision. Please track the mirror validation task in the postmortem and schedule the vendor-first follow-up. :thumbsup:
